milestone: Iterator28: pending SEND with an owning copied detached return
status: Implemented, validated and independently accepted; pointwise composed over a33a254e1/405.
scope: A one-argument literal SEND on a live, inherited-pending detached middle Generator whose child independently completed with an owning copied return at a simple-CV assigned yield from. Exactly that waiting return, no other owning suspended task or HELD value, inactive GC, no borrowed/startpack/loop producer. Ordinary next and explicit close are separate continuations; no parked history.
semantics: YIELD_FROM has no send target. Pending SEND ignores its argument, clears only the actual receiver initialization flag and returns a dereferenced current snapshot without advancing or consuming the owning COMPLETE. Existing argument-before-receiver cleanup applies.

The snapshot precedes ignored-argument destruction: reference-row mutation can cause COW while the returned old row and the owning child return stay separate. Real later next consumes the owning result normally; actual close retains its count through the existing Iterator27 path. Returned arrays retain mutable embedded reference cells.

When an ignored argument destructor throws, its captured return snapshot survives physical receiver close and storage retirement. Exceptional result cleanup then decrements the snapshot before caller catch. A cache destructor can replace the supplied Exception with the original as Previous. Its real saved THROW_SEARCH is the existing borrowed pending anchor; the owning child return remains request-store-late.
source_authority: vendor/php-src/Zend/zend_generators.c::Generator::send calls ensure_initialized/get_current, writes only a nonnull send_target, resumes and RETURN_COPY_DEREFs current. zend_generator_resume clears DO_INIT and returns without advancing when current is defined. zend_generator_update_current supplies the detached copied return.

Zend/zend_vm_def.h::DO_FCALL cleanup frees arguments and releases THIS before HANDLE_EXCEPTION decrements the used call result with zval_ptr_dtor_nogc. The observed receiver/finally/snapshot order follows this route. Iterator27 documents the separate unfinished YIELD_FROM return count and close retention.
These are pinned implementation observations, not portable lifetime guarantees. No engine bug or intentional divergence is classified.
